i.norm: Verifies that JavaVersion.get() throws NumberFormatException when given a version string that contains a non-numeric character (e.g. "0S"). Internally, "0S" falls through to the default switch branch, where the code attempts Float.parseFloat on a substring of the input. The letter 'S' makes the substring unparseable, so Float.parseFloat raises NumberFormatException.
expected: "0S" cannot be parsed as a float, so NumberFormatException is thrown
